notes.title: Translations in Italian and Spanish (Latin America)
notes.notes: Thanks to Julio Compagnoni from Argentinia and Marco Lizza, who were bored during Corona quarantine, we have two new translations: Italian and Spanish (Latin America) ! The pixelart point-and-click adventure "Paul Pixel - The Awakening" is now available in seven languages.

notes.title: New Languages
notes.notes:
Paul Pixel has been translated to [b]Spanish[/b] and [b]Russian[/b]. Thanks to Betty Blaires for the Spanish and Alexander Preymak for the Russian translation.

Have fun!

notes.title: French Translation
notes.notes:
A French translation of "Paul Pixel - The Awakening" will be released next Tuesday. After English and German this will be the third language. Translation was done by Christophe Pallarès.
